title: Nonstationary and adaptive conformal inference
---

**Background:** Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage under exchangeability or weak dependence, but time-series observations are often non-stationary and generated by models where predictors are trained or updated on the same evolving series.

**Question / Future Work:** Extending realized-coverage inference to nonstationary data and predictors trained or updated on the same series remains an open problem beyond the scope of current theoretical frameworks.

**Why It Matters:** Important for practical time-series forecasting where models are continuously retrained or data distributions drift over time.

**Evidence:** Extending realized-coverage inference to nonstationary data and predictors trained or updated or the same series is beyond the scope of this paper and is left for future work.
